_comment: #2374 — typecheck for Playwright specs. tsconfig.json and tsconfig.test.json both exclude e2e/, and Playwright transpiles without typechecking, so a spec's typed mocks (`satisfies` against the BFF wire types) fail on shape drift only if this config runs; `npm run typecheck` runs it. The exclude list below is a ratchet of specs that had type errors when this config landed: fix one, then drop it from the list. Never add to it.
